class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackGME
class.description: Owns the emulator for one playing instance. Its properties are what an [AudioStreamPlayer] sets through [code]parameters/track_index[/code] and [code]parameters/looping[/code]. They can also be set directly on a playback, and track changes apply while playing.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the track restarts when it ends.
Zero-based index of the track to play.
